raw_text: New satellite imagery from Planet Labs shows what appears to be a prefabricated bridge structure near Finger 8 on the north bank of Pangong Tso. The construction pattern is consistent with PLA engineering corps deployments seen in 2020. Multiple concrete abutments are visible, suggesting this is designed for vehicle traffic rather than foot patrols. This could significantly alter the logistics balance in the area.
